capabilities: chat with an AI assistant inside the editor
insert AI responses at the cursor position
run RAG semantic search over the vault with citations
create reusable custom prompts with placeholders
configure model temperature, top-K, top-P and token limits
extras: Full documentation (installation, guides, troubleshooting) lives in an external wiki rather than the README; a free-tier Gemini API key is available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, so talking to your notes or generating content with a language model requires an external tool.

relations.evidence: an intelligent AI writing assistant powered by Google's Gemini AI

summary: AI chat assistant powered by Google Gemini that answers questions about your vault via RAG and inserts generated content at the cursor.
